svg.title: 投票前要睇啲咩
svg.desc: 原則：睇紀錄、睇政績、睇計劃、睇態度

text.font-family: PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif
PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif

svg.text: 投票之前，睇清楚呢幾樣

text.font-family: PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif
PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif

svg.text: 睇佢哋過往搞過嘅活動，睇得唔唔到做得實唔實

text.font-family: PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif
PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif

svg.text: 有冇報告、有冇交代錢用咗喺邊

text.font-family: PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif
PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif

svg.text: 係咪有具體時間表，唔係淨係講「會努力」

text.font-family: PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif
PingFang TC, PingFang HK, Noto Sans CJK TC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Microsoft JhengHei, WenQuanYi Zen Hei, sans-serif

svg.text: 肯唔肯出席答問、肯唔肯講唔做得到嘅部分
原則：睇紀錄、睇政績、睇計劃、睇態度
